Incorporating an ensemble of ligand-based pharmacophore models derived from distinct ERα-binding chemotypes into the reward function, rather than the single reference set used in the paper, will generate molecules with higher predicted ERα/ERβ selectivity and greater scaffold diversity while preserving comparable pharmacophoric fidelity to known actives.
